messages:
marco: Heads-up — planning prod deploy for v2.14.0 tomorrow 09:00 PT. Main change: model routing fallback + small runtime hotfix. @sre-oncall @emma can you confirm rollback/runbook is good?

liam: Thanks — I can be on call for the window. Quick note: the runtime change touches kernel selection; rollback must be able to switch routing to previous model variant and revert config.

emma: I reviewed the runbook and added a short checklist in the doc. Key rollback criteria: 1) error rate > 3% for 5m OR 2) median p99 latency > 1.2s for 10m OR 3) customer-facing failures > 0.5% for 10m.

priya: QA smoke tests prepared. We'll run these immediately after deploy (smoke-1 to smoke-4). If any smoke fails, we abort and rollback. Smoke tests:
- smoke-1: sanity generation on core model (10 requests)
- smoke-2: KV cache warmup verification
- smoke-3: streaming & toolcall flow
- smoke-4: embeddings consistency check

sre-oncall: Ops checklist is ready. I've validated the rollback scripts and put a one-button rollback in staging:

```
# rollback: switch routing + redeploy previous artifact
./infra/runbooks/rollback.sh --env prod --tag v2.13.7
kubectl -n redwood-prod rollout undo deploy/serving-runtime
```

Note: this will cause ~10s additional cold-starts across nodes.

marco: Good. Two quick process items:
1) Who's executing the rollback command if needed?
2) Who will hit Go/No-Go in the final 15m check?

liam: I'll execute the rollback command if we see the thresholds hit and QA confirms.

emma: I'll be the final Go/No-Go and monitor. I'll post reasons if I flip to No-Go.

priya: For timing, deploy window is 09:00–09:30 PT. We'll run smoke tests at +5m. If all green, post a :tada: update and continue. If any fail, we trigger rollback.

marco: Ok — last validation: can someone paste the exact runbook link and the short checklist so I can pin it in the thread?

emma: Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/prod-deploy-rollback-v2.14.0
Checklist (copy):
- Confirm artifact tag v2.14.0 in release notes
- Ensure canary routing disabled (we start at 100% prod)
- Verify autoscaler setpoints unchanged
- Confirm KMS access to keys unchanged
- Pre-deploy: snapshot metrics baseline (error rate, p50/p95/p99, model-serving tokens/s)
- Deploy + wait 5m for stabilization
- Run smoke-1..4 and post results in this thread
- If thresholds exceeded or smoke fails -> rollback.sh, notify infra slack channel, and open incident ticket

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: v2.14.0 -> prod @ 09:00 PT (creator: marco). Canary: none.

marco: Thanks. Emma, Liam, Priya + SRE oncall — please ack in thread if you can cover roles tomorrow at 09:00 PT.

liam: ack — will execute rollback if needed.

emma: ack — will call Go/No-Go.

priya: ack — QA smoke owner, will post results.

sre-oncall: ack — monitoring & alerting watch, will open incident if we roll back.

marco: Perfect. I'll pin the runbook link and set a calendar invite with the 15m pre-check reminder. If anything changes, post here.

liam: one last note: if we do rollback, ops runbook also says to increase logging level for 10m to capture traces. We'll add that to the rollback ticket.

emma: noted. See you all tomorrow. :thumbsup:
